description: Append rows after the last row of a sheet (tab). Values are typed: numbers stay numbers and ISO dates become sheet dates. At most 10000 cells per call. Free on a file Nooticr created or one the customer allowed you to edit; on any other file the customer picked it waits for their approval. Use to add new rows below the existing data in a sheet.

appId.description: Product id; optional when the workspace has one product.

id.description: Spreadsheet id from sheets_create or sheets_list.

items.description: A number, boolean, text or an ISO date (2026-01-31) or datetime; null leaves the cell empty. Text that looks like a formula or number stays text; use {"formula": "=SUM(A1:A3)"} for a formula.

name: sheets_append_rows
title: Append Spreadsheet Rows
